description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (%) of various models across six different datasets—SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI—comparing the performance of MADLLM against three variants: MADLLM w/o prompt pool, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names. For each dataset, four bars are grouped together, corresponding to the four models: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). The legend below the chart identifies each model with its respective color. In most datasets, MADLLM achieves the highest F1 score, with the exception of SMAP, where the MADLLM w/o skip embedding variant performs best. The performance of the MADLLM variants generally decreases when components are removed, indicating the importance of these features. The bars are arranged in a consistent order across the datasets, and no additional visual emphasis such as shading or annotations is applied.
